description: This file defines the Trace2 API for debugging, performance, and telemetry in Git. It includes function declarations, enums, and macros for emitting trace events related to process, thread, region, data, and counters, as well as initialization and configuration functions.

methods.name: trace2_initialize_clock
methods.description: Initializes the Trace2 clock, capturing process start time without allocations or environment inspection.

methods.name: trace2_initialize_fl
methods.description: Initializes the Trace2 tracing facility, emitting version info if targets are enabled.

methods.name: trace2_cmd_start_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'start' event with the original argv.

methods.name: trace2_cmd_exit_fl
methods.description: Emits an 'exit' event with the given code.

methods.name: trace2_cmd_error_va_fl
methods.description: Emits an 'error' event with formatted message.

methods.name: trace2_cmd_path_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'pathname' event with the process's canonical pathname.

methods.name: trace2_cmd_ancestry_fl
methods.description: Emits an 'ancestry' event with parent process names.

methods.name: trace2_cmd_name_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'cmd_name' event with the command's canonical name.

methods.name: trace2_cmd_mode_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'cmd_mode' event describing the command mode.

methods.name: trace2_cmd_alias_fl
methods.description: Emits an 'alias' message with alias and expansion.

methods.name: trace2_cmd_list_config_fl
methods.description: Emits events for important configuration settings.

methods.name: trace2_cmd_list_env_vars_fl
methods.description: Emits events for important environment variables.

methods.name: trace2_cmd_set_config_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'def_param' event for a config key/value pair.

methods.name: trace2_child_start_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'child_start' message with child process info.

methods.name: trace2_child_exit_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'child_exit' message with process exit info.

methods.name: trace2_child_ready_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'child_ready' message indicating process readiness.

methods.name: trace2_exec_fl
methods.description: Emits an 'exec' event before executing a new process.

methods.name: trace2_exec_result_fl
methods.description: Emits an 'exec_result' event after exec attempt.

methods.name: trace2_thread_start_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'thread_start' event.

methods.name: trace2_thread_exit_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'thread_exit' event.

methods.name: trace2_def_param_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'def_param' message with key/value.

methods.name: trace2_def_repo_fl
methods.description: Defines a new repository instance with a repo-id.

methods.name: trace2_region_enter_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'region_enter' event.

methods.name: trace2_region_enter_printf_va_fl
methods.description: Emits a formatted 'region_enter' event.

methods.name: trace2_region_leave_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'region_leave' event.

methods.name: trace2_region_leave_printf_va_fl
methods.description: Emits a formatted 'region_leave' event.

methods.name: trace2_data_string_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'data' event with string value.

methods.name: trace2_data_intmax_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'data' event with integer value.

methods.name: trace2_data_json_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'data' event with JSON value.

methods.name: trace2_printf_va_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'printf' event with formatted message.

methods.name: trace2_printf_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'printf' event with formatted message.

methods.name: trace2_timer_start
methods.description: Starts a stopwatch timer.

methods.name: trace2_timer_stop
methods.description: Stops a stopwatch timer.

methods.name: trace2_counter_add
methods.description: Increments a global counter.

methods.name: trace2_collect_process_info
methods.description: Collects process info for post-processing.

methods.name: trace2_session_id
methods.description: Returns the current session ID.
